name: @kuraa/tauri
description: A prototype of the desktop app as a Tauri shell: the web client in the system's webview, the host run by a Node of its own.

scripts.prepare-host: pnpm --filter @kuraa/web build && node ../../scripts/build-server.mjs && node ../desktop/scripts/fetch-git.mjs && node scripts/fetch-node.mjs && node scripts/stage.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare-host && tauri build --bundles app && node scripts/package-mac.mjs
